A '''[[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]''' was located on the planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a group of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]&mdash;[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], [[Cesi Eirriss]] and [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]]&mdash;visited the cantina during a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission]] to obtain [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].
